Your Opportunity
We currently have exciting opportunities for Senior Consultant, Managers, Senior Managers and Directors across our Tax division.

Corporate Tax Advisory/Corporate Tax DDX
Our Corporate Tax division helps businesses understand corporate tax matters and comply with ATO filing obligations. We recognise that multinational businesses face obstacles in managing tax across different jurisdictions and we use our local and global expertise to cut through the complexity this entails. 

M&A Tax/Stamp Duty
The KPMG State Tax Deals and Stamp Duty teams work on the most significant transactions in the Australian Market. They are market leading teams supporting clients with tax due diligence, structuring, modelling, duty and land tax compliance and dispute resolutions. 

GST Advisory/GST DDX/Employment Tax/Payroll/Trade & Customs
Our Indirect Tax division within the KPMG Specialist Tax and Reward business consists of market leading teams that provide high-touch, value-add advisory and compliance services. We support clients across the market through consulting on FBT, payroll tax, superannuation obligations, GST advice and international trade strategy.

GMS Tax Advisory/GMS DDX
Our Global Mobility Services teams are part of the KPMG People Services business in Australia and offers both Australian and international tax services to clients. We work across all areas of Global Mobility and related tax matters providing a high-touch, value-add advisory and compliance services to our clients.

Performance & Reward
KPMG’s Performance & Reward team is our leading remuneration practice advising ASX200 and unlisted company Boards and C-Site on remuneration and reward issues. We help our clients implement remuneration plans to reward and retain their people.

Migration DDX
Our national immigration practice is a team of registered migration agents and administrators that manage the visa requirements involved in the relocation of individuals and their families from one country to another by working closely with taxation specialists and global mobility professionals. 

Transfer Pricing 
Our Transfer Pricing Services practice is an international team of economists, tax practitioners and analysts helping clients generate tax efficiencies and reduce the risk of challenges from revenue authorities. Our multi-disciplinary approach and global mindset enable us to cover issues such as developing and executing commercially viable transfer pricing policies, compiling documentation for revenue authority audits and complying with local revenue requirements.

Tax Governance & Transparency
The Tax Governance & Transparency team advises organisations nationally and internationally on better practices in respect of tax governance and sustainability through tax transparency and risk management disciplines. 

Tax Reimagined
Our Tax Transformation team assist clients in transforming their tax functions to increase efficiency, improve governance and accuracy of their tax reporting. 

Tax Controversy
Our Tax Controversy team complements KPMG's traditional service offerings by providing high-quality legal services to our clients. The team prepare for, manage and resolve tax disputes, whilst maintaining an effective working relationship with revenue authorities.

How are you extraordinary?
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines
•	You actively seek out opportunities for growth, are comfortable challenging the status quo, and enjoy getting out of your comfort zone

Your Experience
To be considered for this opportunity, your qualifications, skills & experience could include:

Corporate Tax Advisory/Corporate Tax DDX
•	Advisory and compliance experience
•	High level of commitment to quality client service
•	Preferably CA/CPA qualified or with a Master’s of Taxation.

M&A Tax/Stamp Duty
•	Demonstrated experience as a Finance/Accounting/Law professional, ideally with significant recent experience in duty in an M&A/ transactional tax environment
•	You are passionate about the importance of fantastic communication to share ideas, inspire and create change. You are able to digest, distil, and communicate complex concepts in both written and verbal forms.

GST Advisory/GST DDX/Employment Tax/Payroll/Trade & Customs
•	A degree in Accounting, Commerce or other relevant disciplines
•	You enjoy working in the details, with a proactive attitude towards accuracy and deadlines
•	You are analytically minded and enjoy applying structured thinking and analysis techniques to complex problems.,

GMS Tax Advisory/GMS DDX
•	Experience with expatriate tax compliance issues, with strong Tax compliance knowledge, including preparation and/or review of company and trust income tax returns, distribution reviews and tax provisions

Performance & Reward
•	A broad mix of technical knowledge suited to working in the Leadership, Performance and Reward space
•	Sector experience within consulting, a large listed corporate, or government
•	You like to be proud of the work you produce and are accountable and committed to owning high-profile projects.

Migration DDX
•	Must be a Registered Migration Agent with sound understanding of migration legislation in a high-volume environment
•	You are committed to providing fantastic customer service, with kindness and empathy at the heart of every interaction.

Transfer Pricing 
•	Prior transfer pricing experience in a Big 4 or mid-tier firm, the ATO or corporate environment
•	A degree in Accounting, Economics, Commerce, Finance or Law, and/or undertaking/completion of the CA/CPA

Tax Governance & Transparency

Tax Reimagined

Tax Controversy

Service Coordinator - Part Time - Welshpool 
 Our client is seeking an experienced and adaptable Service Coordinator to join their team in Welshpool in a part-time capacity, working 3 days per week. 
 This opportunity is for a minimum 6-month assignment, with the potential to be extended. 
 This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced service environment, coordinating technicians, supporting customers, and helping maintain smooth day-to-day service operations. 
 What's on offer 
 
 $37.00 per hour 
 Part-time opportunity 
 3 days per week 
 Minimum 6-month assignment, with potential for extension 
 Flexible on days 
 Welshpool location 
 7.6 hour days 
 Flexible shift options including:
 
 7:00am - 3:00pm 
 8:00am - 4:00pm 
 
 
 
 About the role 
 Reporting to the Service Manager, the Service Coordinator is responsible for helping ensure effective and efficient service delivery to customers. 
 You will work closely with service technicians, customers and internal stakeholders to coordinate service activity, manage schedules, support job workflow, and help maintain a high standard of customer service. 
 This role will support the current Service Coordinators and provide additional resourcing to a busy team. The broader team operates between 6:00am and 6:00pm, so flexibility is important to meet changing business needs when required. 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 Coordinate and schedule service technicians for routine maintenance, installations and emergency repairs 
 Optimise scheduling to ensure efficient use of technician time and resources 
 Facilitate site entry and mobilisation requirements 
 Monitor technician availability and adjust schedules to accommodate urgent requests and changes 
 Assess customer service needs and recommend appropriate service plans 
 Ensure all costs are applied to service work orders in a timely manner 
 Generate invoices following service in line with company guidelines 
 Maintain and update relevant databases and service records 
 Keep accurate and up-to-date records of customer interactions and service delivery 
 Prepare reports on service utilisation, customer outcomes and effectiveness 
 Assist in improving service coordination processes and procedures 
 Build strong relationships with technicians, customers and internal departments including sales and parts 
 Conduct regular follow-up to support ongoing customer satisfaction 
 
 What we're looking for 
 To be successful in this role, you will have: 
 
 Strong organisational and time management skills 
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 
 The ability to work collaboratively with internal teams and external stakeholders 
 Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail 
 The ability to remain calm in high-pressure situations and manage urgent requests 
 Proficiency in scheduling software and the Microsoft Office Suite 
 A customer-focused and proactive approach 
 A current C Class driver's licence 
 The flexibility and adaptability to work in a busy, changing environment 
 
 Apply now 
 This is a strong opportunity for a capable  Service Coordinator  looking for a  part-time role, 3 days per week , in  Welshpool  with a business that values flexibility, responsiveness and strong service support. 
 
     Please  click here  to apply.

About Dipole Group
We are a wholly Australian owned and operated ICT and Telecom networks specialist delivery business. Dipole operates locally, regionally, and internationally. Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The Role
The ICT Support Engineer develops support procedures and strategies for systems, networks, operating systems and applications development. This role provides technical expertise and direction in support of system infrastructure and process improvements, diagnoses and resolves complex system problems, and ensures the delivery of high-quality 24/7 technical support services. 

Key Responsibilities:
•	Diagnose and resolve complex technical problems related to hardware, software, networks, and systems infrastructure, including installation, maintenance, repair, upgrade, and configuration of desktops, servers, email, databases, operating systems, and security systems.
•	Develop and implement support procedures and strategies for systems, networks, operating systems, and applications development, defining escalation, response, and resolution timeframes based on criticality and impact.
•	Prioritise and triage incoming incidents and service requests to ensure timely response and appropriate escalation, managing Incident and Change queues to ensure service restoration and completion within agreed SLAs.
•	Act as the primary escalation point of contact for onshore and offshore teams, managing High Impact Incidents across affected lines of business and driving restoration within agreed timeframes.
•	Test, identify, and diagnose functionality errors and faults in systems and programming code within established testing protocols, guidelines, and quality standards to ensure systems perform to specification.
•	Perform organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, recommending current and future hardware and software strategies and directions to facilitate business growth and agility.
•	Develop, conduct, and provide technical guidance and training in application software and operational procedures for team members, ensuring continuous upskilling and knowledge transfer.
•	Create and review technical documentation such as procedural, instructional, and operational guides, technical reports, specifications, and maintenance inventory systems.
•	Schedule and conduct quality audit inspections, analysing and reviewing systems, data, and documentation to identify variations and potential high-risk areas in securing adherence to standards and procedures.
•	Recommend corrective action plans and improvements in the resolution of non-compliance with standards detected through monitoring and auditing of processes and procedures.
•	Communicate, educate, and liaise with users and management to ensure awareness and adherence to standards, procedures, and quality control issues, while interacting with clients to determine satisfaction levels and areas of potential dissatisfaction.
•	Lead infrastructure projects as Project Manager, monitoring and controlling project time, cost, quality, and risks throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring all business and technical requirements are met.

Next Steps

Due to the high number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion within 3-5 business days. We thank you for taking an interest in this opportunity with us.

Salary: From  80,001 to 90,000 AUD per annum plus Superannuation.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Transform lives, every single day

Do you want a career that means more? At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, the support and the strategy to make it happen. 

For over 170 years, Anglicare has supported people and communities across Sydney and the surrounds. Our Seniors Communities portfolio spans Retirement Living and Support at Home services, supporting thousands of older Australians and their families. 

We'relooking for aCyberRisk andControls Analystto join our Cyber Security and IT Risk team. This role focuses onperforming risk assessmentsin accordancewiththe team's practises andguidelines as well as implementing andassessingcyber security controls,in alignment to the Cyber uplift program,supporting governance and compliance initiatives, and helping strengthen Anglicare's cyber security posture. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, you will contribute to controls assurance activities, risk assessments and continuous monitoring programs that help protect Anglicare's critical systems,dataand digital assets.

As part of a purpose-driven organisation, you'll be working in a collaborative and values-led environment where your work directly contributes to enriching lives and strengthening communities. 

Your opportunity

TheCyber Risk and Controls Analystplaysan important rolein supporting Anglicare's cyber security governance, risk management,and to alesser degree,controlsimplementation andassuranceactivities. You willdeterminesecurityeffectivenessthrough risk assessments,aswell as implementing and assessing cyber security controls, in alignment to the Cyber uplift program,monitorcompliance with security frameworks and standards, and provide insights that help strengthen cyber resilience across the organisation.

Working alongside Cyber Security, ITArchitectureand business stakeholders, you will support control validation, governance frameworks, riskassessmentsand remediation initiatives while helping ensure Anglicaremaintainsa secure and resilient technology environment.

With ownership, you will:

You will support the development and maintenance of governance and compliance frameworks, conduct risk assessments and gap analyses,monitorcontrol performance and remediation activities, and contribute to security assurance initiatives. You will also prepare reports and documentation, support governanceprocessesand work closely with stakeholders to strengthen cyber security controls and reduce organisational risk.

What you'll bring

You are a cyber security professional with experience inrisk assessments,controls assurance,complianceandgovernance. You have agoodunderstanding of cyber security control frameworks,in particular the SCF framework,compliancerequirementsand security best practices, and enjoy analysing complex environments toidentifycontrol gaps and opportunities for improvement.

You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent communication and stakeholder engagement capabilities. You are detail-oriented,collaborativeand proactive, with the ability to translate technical findings into practical recommendations that support business and securityobjectives. You are also committed to continuous learning and staying informed about emerging threats,technologiesand regulatory developments.

You will also need:

- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Cyber Security, RiskManagementor a related field. Certifications such as CRISC, CISM or ISO 27001 are highly desirable.
- 3+ years' experience in cyber security, governance, riskmanagementor compliance-related roles.
- Experience assessing andvalidatingcyber security controls and supporting controls assurance activities.
- Knowledge of cyber security frameworks and standards including SCF, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53 and CIS Controls.
- Experience with control testing, evidence review, gap analysis and remediation tracking.
- Understanding of continuous control monitoring, compliancereportingand security assurance practices.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and risk assessment capabilities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong documentation and reporting skills with exceptional attention to detail.
- Proven ability to collaborate effectively across teams and contribute to organisation-wide cyber security and governance initiatives.

Why Anglicare?

At Anglicare, we provide meaningful opportunities and choice - both for the communities we support and the people who work with us. 

Here'swhatyou'llenjoy: 

Flexible work options to balance life and career. 

Salary packaging benefits - up to $15,900 of your income tax free, plus $2,650 for meals and entertainment. 

Ongoing professional development and career pathways. 

Exclusive staff discounts with over 400 retailers. 

Employee Assistance Program and Fitness Passport with access to 800+ gyms. 

Belonging to a supportive, purpose-driven team committed to making a difference. 

Apply now

Are you ready to help us attract and empower the people who will shape Anglicare's future? To apply, click the'Apply'button andsubmityour resum and cover letter. All applicants will receive a response. Anglicare is as wonderfully diverse as the communities we serve. While guided by our Christian values, our team includes people of all faiths and backgrounds.

We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, and people of all ages, genders,abilitiesand cultural backgrounds.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your role at St John of God Medicare Mental Health Service Armadale

We are seeking an enthusiastic and compassionate Administration Officer to join our Medicare Mental Health Service in Armadale on a permanent part-time basis.

As an Administration Officer, you will play an important role in supporting the delivery of a welcoming, accessible, and client-focused service. You will provide high-quality administrative and clerical support to the team, while creating a positive first point of contact for clients, their families, and carers accessing our service. You will also support caregivers with a range of administrative tasks that enable the effective delivery of mental health services.

The Armadale Medicare Mental Health Centre provides free, easily accessible support for people aged 18 years and over. We offer a welcoming and inclusive environment where individuals can access mental health information, services, and support from qualified professionals, without the need for an appointment or referral.

Our service is delivered by dedicated mental health professionals, with clients supported from the moment they arrive by trained peer workers who provide guidance and connection throughout their experience. This is an opportunity to contribute to a service that helps people access the right support at the right time.

The Position

Provide administrative support to the Service Manager and team.

Establish and manage effective and efficient office management systems.

Prioritise and coordinate work to meet designated time frames.

Manage the electronic client management system (CMS) for client records and administrative information.

Assist caregivers with the collection of data for quality indicators, finance reports and service specific statistics.

Support data extraction and analytics for benchmarking.

Provide secretarial support to service meetings.

Ensure typing and distribution of minutes, correspondence and memos are completed in an accurate and timely manner.

Arrange venues, equipment and catering for all service events.

Manage an effective filing system for client records and administrative information, including manual and electronic systems.

Assist in the design and desktop production of presentations, fliers, reports and publications.

You will hold strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build positive relationships and engage effectively with a diverse client base, caregivers, and stakeholders. Whilst providing a welcoming and supportive experience for individuals accessing the service, you will have the ability to respond with professionalism and empathy to their needs.

The successful applicant will have solid experience in reception and office administration, with an understanding of systems and processes used to manage client information, appointments, and data collection. You will demonstrate a high level of customer service, with strong verbal and written communication skills, excellent attention to detail and accurate data entry capabilities.

In addition, you will possess sound planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks, manage competing demands, and work effectively in a busy service environment. 

A current WA driver's licence and National Police Clearance are essential for this role.

Above all, patient care will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

Salary: $74,627 to $78,011 (pro-rata for part-time) plus 12% Superannuation

Permanent part-time, working 20 hours per week

Monday to Friday | 8.30 to 12.30pm

Salary packaging up to $18,550 on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses as well as options to salary package benefits above the FBT cap on items such as:

Novated leasing 

work related expenses

self-education and

additional superannuation

A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options, additional purchased leave & well-being programs

Access to gym membership, fitness and wellbeing benefits through Fitness Passport for you and your family.

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Innovative Professional Development opportunities

All applicants are asked to submit a current CV and covering letter (of no more than two (2) pages) demonstrating how you meet the above position requirements.

For enquiries contact Liam Dekker, Manager Medicare Mental Health Service on 0437 020 195.

Applications will be reviewed throughout the advertising period and interviews conducted regularly. If suitable applicants are identified advertisement may close prior to listed date. Apply today!

Our commitment is to create a safe and nurturing environment for all children and vulnerable individuals in our care and proactively take steps to protect them from abuse, ensuring their safety and well-being. 

Our inclusive culture fosters an environment that is respectful and secure, welcoming and accessible, and unified through our diverse community.    Click here to Apply now →
